note: Checked 17 October 2026; the Alan Turing Way and Broughton and Monsall items were checked on 20 October. Times are BST until the clocks go back at 02:00 on Sunday 25 October; Sunday 25 times are GMT. Prices, stock and travel alerts can change, and kick-off times can move for TV.

cards.title: Clocks go back on Sunday
cards.body: British Summer Time ends at 02:00 on Sunday 25 October, when clocks go back one hour to 01:00 GMT. Phones change automatically, but check car, oven and heating timers. United's 14:00 kick-off that afternoon is GMT.
cards.mg_alt: Clock face showing the hour hand moving back from 2 to 1.

cards.headline: 19 OCT → 01 NOV
cards.title: Two-week tram shutdown starts Monday
cards.body: No trams run on the Altrincham, Trafford Centre and Eccles lines until Sunday 1 November. East Didsbury and Airport trams terminate at Firswood, and Rochdale trams at Exchange Square. Express shuttle buses link key stops with Piccadilly, 7-day, 28-day and annual pass holders can use selected trains and buses, and Starling Bike rides of up to 20 minutes near the works are free.
cards.mg_alt: Tram line diagram: Altrincham, Eccles and Trafford Centre lines closed; Airport and East Didsbury trams terminate at Firswood.

cards.title: Alan Turing Way still shut northbound
cards.body: Alan Turing Way is closed northbound from Ashton Old Road to Grey Mare Lane. The emergency closure has been in place since March, with no reopening date. Drivers are diverted via Pin Mill Brow, Great Ancoats Street, Every Street and Ashton New Road. Allow extra time on Tuesday's match night and the Westlife nights at Co-op Live, Friday to Sunday.
cards.where: Ashton Old Rd to Grey Mare Lane
cards.mg_alt: Diagram: Alan Turing Way northbound closed from Ashton Old Road to Grey Mare Lane; drivers divert via Pin Mill Brow, Great Ancoats Street, Every Street and Ashton New Road.

cards.title: Champions League night at the Etihad
cards.body: Manchester City host AEK Athens at 20:00 on Tuesday. Trams keep running on the Ashton line through the works, so Etihad Campus is served, but expect busy trams and roads around the stadium before and after the game. City's travel page posts matchday updates.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Tuesday 20 October marked, 20:00 kick-off.

cards.title: M60 J18 slip to the M66 shut overnight
cards.body: The clockwise exit slip at M60 junction 18, Simister Island, to the M66 northbound closes overnight from 21:00 to 06:00, Monday to Friday. The signed 7-mile diversion continues on the M62 eastbound to junction 19, then returns westbound to junction 18. The same closure repeats from 26 to 31 October.
cards.mg_alt: Junction diagram: M60 clockwise exit slip at junction 18 to the M66 north is closed overnight.

cards.title: Road works in Broughton and Monsall
cards.body: SP Electricity North West is working on two streets in Broughton. Great Cheetham Street East has a one-way closure from Wednesday to Friday, then signals until 10 November. St James Road closes on Saturday and Sunday, with signals at other times. Separately, 114 buses miss stops in Monsall and on Queens Road until Friday, diverting via The Gateway and Oldham Road.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip: Wednesday to Friday marked one-way for Great Cheetham Street East, Saturday and Sunday marked closed for St James Road, and a bar to Friday for the 114 diversion.

cards.title: Old Trafford matchday with no trams
cards.body: Manchester United host Bournemouth at 14:00 on Sunday, during the tram shutdown, so no trams serve Wharfside, Exchange Quay or Old Trafford. The Trafford Centre express shuttle bus calls at Wharfside and Imperial War Museum every 15 minutes. Expect long queues after the final whistle and busy roads around Trafford.
cards.mg_alt: Diagram: Trafford Centre tram line closed; the express shuttle bus stops at Wharfside, nearest the stadium.

cards.title: Sunday rail closures around Victoria
cards.body: Engineering work closes all lines between Victoria and Stalybridge, and between Victoria and Moston. TransPennine trains to Leeds, York and Newcastle run from Piccadilly instead. Northern's Leeds trains start at Rochdale, with buses from Victoria, and there are no trains to Blackburn via Todmorden. Four early TransPennine trains skip Victoria on Monday morning.
cards.mg_alt: Rail diagram: Victoria to Stalybridge closed; Victoria to Rochdale replaced by buses, trains start at Rochdale.

cards.title: Free warm spaces in every library
cards.body: Every Manchester library is a free warm space this winter, with seating, Wi-Fi, free SIM cards, newspapers and staff who can point you to support. Free hot drinks start on Monday and run until February. Chorlton, Longsight, Newton Heath and Withington libraries now open on Sundays too. Cost-of-living helpline: 0800 023 2692, weekdays 09:00–16:30.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with a bar starting Monday 19 October and continuing to February 2027.

cards.title: Manchester's archives catalogue goes online
cards.body: A free online catalogue now covers more than 3,000 collections from Manchester Archives and the Greater Manchester Record Office. Search by name, place, subject or reference, and book Search Room time to see originals. Archives staff run a drop-in at Central Library on Tuesday from 11:00 to 14:00.

cards.title: H&M men's sale
cards.body: H&M UK lists 584 men's sale lines. The biggest cuts include a pyjama set at £8, down from £37.99, and a Premium Selection wool-blend double-breasted jacket at £36, down from £139.99. Sizes, stock and prices change quickly.
cards.where: H&M UK online · store stock unconfirmed

cards.title: Zara special prices
cards.body: Zara UK's women's Special Prices edit is mostly autumn knitwear and tailoring. Examples include an oversize argyle jumper at £19.99, down from £45.99, and a plain knit cape at £22.99, down from £49.99. Available online and in stores; check your size locally.
cards.what: Special Prices · up to 56% on examples

cards.title: Currys clearance
cards.body: Currys lists 644 clearance items, down from 694 last week. Examples include an Acer Swift X 14 AI laptop at £1,050.97, saving £548.03, and a Sharper Image massage gun at £19.99, saving £12.98. The Central Retail Park Clearance Store on Great Ancoats Street opens from 10:00 on weekdays; check hours before going.

cards.title: Literature Festival's final week
cards.body: Manchester Literature Festival ends on 25 October. Still to come: Sufiyaan Salam and Monika Radojevic at Manchester Museum on Sunday at 17:00, Lady Hale and Lara Feigel at Central Library on Wednesday at 19:00, and Karen Solie's Rylands Poetry Reading at the John Rylands Library on Thursday at 19:00.
cards.where: Manchester Museum / Central Library / John Rylands
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Sunday 18, Wednesday 21 and Thursday 22 October marked.

cards.title: Sale Makers Market
cards.body: Independent makers sell handmade food, crafts and gifts on School Road in Sale town centre. Trams still run to Sale on Sunday; the Altrincham line shutdown starts on Monday.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Sunday 18 October marked, 11:00 to 16:00.

cards.title: MediaCityUK Makers Market
cards.body: Local makers sell handmade food, crafts, jewellery and gifts at Quayside MediaCityUK. No trams reach MediaCityUK during the shutdown; the express shuttle bus from Piccadilly via Deansgate-Castlefield runs every 15 minutes.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Saturday 24 October marked, 10:00 to 17:00.
